description: Low-level/legacy: create a blank link-in-bio scaffold from a style preset (title, displayName, preset or 'auto'). Not for normal page requests — use page_create_from_brief, which builds the page from the user's details. The scaffold starts with empty placeholder blocks to fill via block_update — do not invent content. This tool intentionally creates a draft only and does not return a publish action. After calling it, stop and show the preview URL. Do not call page_publish in the same turn unless the user's current message explicitly asks to publish, make the page live, or get a public share link. Anonymous demo pages expire unless claimed.

bio.description: Optional short bio for the header.

businessType.description: Used by preset:auto inference. Examples: musician, restaurant, designer.

displayName.description: Visible header display name. Defaults to title.

preset.description: Style preset id, or 'auto' to infer deterministically from businessType/style.

style.description: Free-form style hint used by preset:auto inference.

title.description: Internal page title and default header display_name.

name: page_create

liveUpdateMessage.description: Plain-language instruction explaining that an edit to an already-published page is draft-only and must not be published until a later explicit user request.

liveUpdateRequired.description: True after an edit to an already-published page when the public live page still needs page_publish to reflect the latest revision.

nextSteps.description: Improvement hints. Only 'required' items block publishing (they mirror the publish guard); 'recommended' and 'optional' are suggestions to offer after the user has seen the preview, never prerequisites.

publishPolicy.description: For edit tools on already-published pages, this is wait_for_separate_user_request to prevent same-turn publishing.

title: Create Landing Page
